verdict.rationale: Bruno lets teams write docs alongside collections and publish them as shareable HTML. It also offers an embeddable README button that opens a collection in Bruno, and teams can share collections through Git. Together these give a rough way to distribute API docs and collections, but nothing is evidenced as a catalog or portal, and Bruno's offline-only, no-cloud-sync stance rules out a hosted discovery hub. Missing for 10: a searchable internal API catalog or portal, hosted or private API network publishing, cross-team discovery and access controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTML publishing.
